EYEWEAR TO SET YOURSELF APART

Shades, sunnies, sunglasses; call them what you will but these trendy accessories can immediately help outfits stand out. Myntra's splendid selection of eyewear awaits you. Featuring everything from wayfarers to aviators, round, and rectangular designs. There are creations to suit every face shape. Fuller faces will love the angular square eyewear that gives the illusion of a slimmer silhouette. Meanwhile, large round shades can instantly widen longer faces. Take your pick from MANGO and Fastrack and more. Settle for a unisex number with self printed frames to give solid outfits some gorgeous texture. You can wear them with anything but we recommend flaunting it with sheer white shirts and flowing palazzo pants for a summery vibe. You can also wear them with chino shorts and striped Henley T-shirts for a nautical-inspired look.

FLAUNT ACCESSORIES WITH A DESIGNER FLAIR

Myntra's eyewear online continues to delight with shades featuring colourful yellow lenses and printed frames. We also carry bikers' sunglasses that you can sport while cruising the streets on your ride. With complete UV defence, you can be sure to stay better protected even on the sunniest of days. The stylised aviators frames are something else. We love the gunmetal-toned creations with brown-green lenses that look awesome when paired with cargo pants, T-shirts, and jackets for rugged styling. Make them your go-to eyewear for outdoor activities and when you just want to give ensembles an extra masculine vibe.

LOOK GOOD AND FEEL GOOD

Buy eyewear from Myntra to effortlessly complete your attire. DIESEL, Louis Philippe, and Ray-Ban are just some of the other fabulous choices you have. Shop for men's sunglasses as well as women's shades and trendy unisex sunnies. Grab your favourite oversize eyewear with a celeb-inspired appeal and show them off with outfits that are just as chic. At Myntra, we understand that style matters, which is why you'll always find some of the trendiest creations.
